title: A sixth-order compact time-splitting Fourier pseudospectral method for the Dirac equation
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel sixth-order compact time-splitting scheme, denoted as $ S_{6\text{c}}$, for solving the Dirac equation in the absence of external magnetic potentials. This method is easy to implement, and it provides a substantial reduction in computational complexity compared to the existing sixth-order splitting schemes. By incorporating a time-ordering technique, we also extend $S_{6\text{c}}$ to address problems with time-dependent potentials.
